pages.title: Planck-Scale Cutter
pages.text: Slices boules into wafers, and wafers into dies, along cuts one Planck length wide.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

The $(thing)Planck length$(), about 1.6 x 10^-35 m, is where our physics gives out - the scale at which quantum gravity should take over. A cut that thin wastes nothing. I still cannot explain how the blade exists.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Cherenkov Wafer, Cosmic Die, Fractal Dust, Hyperdimensional Die, Hyperdimensional Wafer, Ordinal Shard, Photonic Die, Qubit Die, Spacetime Slag, Topological Die, Topological Wafer, Turbomolecular Rotor, Warm Helium.
